title: Bangladesh Army Sainik Recruitment 2026: Circular Guide
metaDescription: Bangladesh Army Sainik circular 2026: age 17-20, SSC GPA 3.00, physical and medical standards, apply online at sainik.teletalk.com.bd, fee details.
headline: Bangladesh Army Sainik Recruitment 2026: Full Circular Guide

sections.content:
The Bangladesh Army recruits Sainik (soldier) personnel through periodic job circulars published on the official recruitment portal. The 2026 circulars cover general trade posts for both male and female candidates, technical trade posts for males, and driver posts, with recruitment carried out in phases by headquarters and branch recruitment units.

Each circular specifies the number of posts, district-wise quotas, application window, and the designated cantonments where selection activities take place. Candidates should read the official circular image or PDF carefully, since dates, fees and trade-wise requirements vary between phases.
sections.title: Sainik Job Circular 2026: Overview

sections.content:
General trade applicants must be between 17 and 20 years old, while technical trade candidates may be 17 to 21 and drivers 18 to 21, counted from the date stated in the circular. Affidavits are not accepted as age proof. Candidates must be Bangladeshi citizens by birth and unmarried, and must know how to swim.

Educationally, general posts require SSC or equivalent with a minimum GPA of 3.00. Technical posts need SSC in the vocational group with GPA 3.00 from an approved board, while driver posts need SSC with GPA 3.00 plus demonstrated driving skill with legal documents or a TTTI certificate.
sections.title: Eligibility: Age, Education and Nationality

sections.content:
Male candidates must be at least 1.68 meters (5 feet 6 inches) tall, weigh 49.90 kg, and have a chest measurement of 30 inches normal expanding to 32 inches. Female candidates need 1.60 meters height and 47 kg weight. Tribal candidates from hill tracts receive slight height relaxations.

The physical fitness test includes running, push-ups, sit-ups, long jump and high jump, and failure in any event can disqualify a candidate. The medical examination covers vision including color blindness screening, blood pressure, heart and lung function, dental health and mental fitness.
sections.title: Physical and Medical Standards

sections.content:
Applications are submitted online through sainik.teletalk.com.bd or joinbangladesharmy.army.mil.bd, where candidates fill in personal and academic information and upload a recent photograph. The application fee is typically 200 to 300 Taka, payable through the Teletalk mobile system, and candidates must apply before the deadline stated in the circular.

Shortlisted candidates report to their assigned cantonment for the selection sequence: physical fitness test, medical examination, written examination covering Bangla, English and general mathematics at SSC level, and a final interview. Original certificates must be presented during verification.
